meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对比本地代码与已发布版本，列出未发布的变更
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要知道哪些代码改动还没发布到npm
copy.tagline_en: Compare local code with published npm versions and list unpublished changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to know which code changes are not yet published to npm

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会对比当前代码与最新发布的 npm 版本，按发布层列出所有未发布的变更，并描述每个变更的实际内容及其重要性。
howto.when: 当你提到“未发布的变更”、“更新日志”、“有什么变化”或“有什么新内容”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 列出所有未发布的变更。
say.note: Claude 会分析代码差异并按层分类输出。

say.text: 检查 oh-my-opencode 有哪些未发布的新功能。
say.note: Claude 会针对该包进行变更分析。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude compares the current code with the latest published npm versions, lists all unpublished changes by release layer, and describes the real changes and why they matter.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'unpublished changes', 'changelog', 'what changed', or 'what's new'.

say_en.note: Claude will analyze code diffs and output by layer.

say_en.text: Check what's new in oh-my-opencode that hasn't been published.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze changes for that package.
